title: NonCollapseRuntimeTrace
description: A normalized runtime trace suitable for non-collapse evaluation.

source.description: Whether this trace came from a test vector or live system

action.description: The action the system took or attempted

context.description: The context in which the action occurred

system_behavior.description: Description of what the system actually did

authorization_present.description: Whether explicit authorization was obtained before action

side_effect_produced.description: Whether the action produced a side effect in the real world

governance_gate_consulted.description: Whether the governance gate was consulted before execution

timestamp.description: When this trace was captured or generated
